defects.title: Module dependency rules — CashTenderHandlerModule depends on Billing but ApprovedEdges test expects 9/9 pass without evidence folder
defects.invariant: All module dependencies declared in IModule.DependsOn must be explicitly listed in ModuleBoundaryTests.ApprovedEdges dictionary with matching module-dependency-rules.md documentation
defects.mechanism: ModuleBoundaryTests.cs:105-108 shows CashTenderHandlerModule DependsOn includes "Billing" (line 20 of CashTenderHandlerModule.cs). The ApprovedEdges dictionary entry at lines 105-108 documents this edge. However, low-C.md:17 notes '9/9 sonucu koşulmadı; kanıt klasörü yok' — the test passes (9 edges approved) but there is no evidence folder demonstrating the test execution. The test itself (ModuleBoundaryTests.DeclaredDependenciesStayWithinTheApprovedEdgeList) validates the edge exists in ApprovedEdges, which it does, but the finding suggests the original audit expected a separate evidence folder that was never created.
defects.acceptance: Create evidence folder for V1-RMD-248 showing ModuleBoundaryTests execution with 9/9 pass, or update finding to historical-fixed if test now passes in CI. The ApprovedEdges entry is present and correct; only evidence artifact is missing.

limitations: Test execution not performed in this review. The ApprovedEdges dictionary correctly includes the Cash.TenderHandler -> Billing edge. Finding appears to be about missing evidence artifact, not an actual code defect.
